title: Almond and Raspberry Cupcakes
blurb: Light cupcakes made with almond flour and topped with fresh raspberries. A simple teatime treat with a delicate almond flavour.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with 10 paper cases.
Beat the butter and coconut sugar together in a bowl until pale and fluffy.
Crack in the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then stir in the almond extract.
Fold in the almond flour and baking powder until just combined, then add the water to loosen the batter slightly.
Divide the mixture between the paper cases and press a few raspberries into the top of each one.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean, then leave to cool on a wire rack.
